nodes.description: Constant public mint price of 0.03 ETH (30000000000000000 wei).
Maximum token supply, initialized to 5555.
Mutable nonce incremented on every hash round and mixed into the keccak256 seed.
Owner-reserved supply counter, decremented by privateMint/bakeReservedPizza/giveAway.
Public boolean pause flag initialised to true, gating bakePizza.
mapping(uint256 => Trait[]) holding every trait per trait-type index; writable by owner functions.
mapping(string => bool) preventing duplicate generated hashes.
Internal mapping(uint256 => string) storing the generated hash per token id.
Private mapping(address => bool) controlling private mint eligibility.
Extra owner address shadowing Ownable._owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor.
Declared address state variable that is never assigned or used.
Internal view function mapping an input 0-5555 to a rarity index string using TIERS bounds; reverts when unmatched.
Internal recursive function building a 9-character hash from keccak256 of block.timestamp, block.difficulty, token id, address and SEED_NONCE.
Internal mint loop: computes hashes, records hashToMinted and mints tokens to the recipient; loop is bounded by _quantity.
Payable public mint entry point; checks msg.value, supply, per-wallet cap and pause flag, then calls mintInternal.
Whitelist-only single-token mint that consumes the caller's whitelist slot and decrements RESERVED.
Public view function converting a hash string into an on-chain SVG using traitTypes.
Public view function converting a hash string into the JSON attributes array using traitTypes.
Overridden tokenURI that base64-encodes the SVG and metadata for an existing token.
Public view accessor returning tokenIdToHash[_tokenId].
Public view function enumerating all token ids owned by a wallet.
onlyOwner function deleting traitTypes entries for indexes 3 to 7.
onlyOwner function appending a caller-supplied array of Trait structs to a chosen traitTypes index.
onlyOwner function transferring the entire contract balance to msg.sender.
onlyOwner mint of reserved tokens; decrements RESERVED then calls mintInternal.
onlyOwner mint of reserved tokens to an arbitrary address; decrements RESERVED then calls mintInternal.
onlyOwner function marking an array of addresses as whitelisted.
onlyOwner function toggling the _paused flag.
Pizza constructor: sets _owner, populates traitTypes and TIERS arrays with initial trait data.
Private function invoking onERC721Received on recipient contracts, a re-entrancy callback surface.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, whitelist key and withdrawal destination.
Miner-influenced timestamp mixed into the keccak256 randomness of hash().
Loop condition 'i <= _quantity' plus 'totalSupply().add(_quantity)' permit an off-by-one extra mint and index arithmetic on _totalSupply + i.
Unsigned subtraction 'RESERVED -= _amount' executed before minting, a state-ordering hazard on the reserved counter.
msg.value compared to the fixed price without enforcing exact payment or refunding excess.
Balance transfer to msg.sender after reading address(this).balance in one state-changing external call.
External call from _checkOnERC721Received into an arbitrary recipient contract, a classic reentrancy callback.
Public mint quantity argument of bakePizza.
Internal mint quantity argument of mintInternal.
Reserved mint amount argument of bakeReservedPizza.
Reserved mint amount argument of giveAway.
Recipient address argument of giveAway.
Token id argument of tokenURI.
Wallet address argument of walletOfOwner.
Trait-type index argument of addTraitType.
Address array argument of updateWhitelist.
Boolean value argument of pause.
Hash string argument of hashToSVG.
Hash string argument of hashToMetadata.
Local accumulator string built across the nine rounds of hash().
Local snapshot of totalSupply() used as the base token id in mintInternal.
Local token id computed as _totalSupply + i inside the mintInternal loop.
Local uint holding address(this).balance before transfer in withdrawFunds.
Local cumulative rarity lower bound walked across the TIERS array in rarityGen.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used directly as the mint recipient and per-wallet limit subject in bakePizza.
Whitelist eligibility and slot consumption in privateMint are keyed on msg.sender.
withdrawFunds pushes the whole contract balance to the caller-controlled msg.sender.
onlyOwner-gated reserved mint whose result is attributed to msg.sender.
onlyOwner-gated whitelist mutation reachable only through the owner identity of msg.sender.
block.timestamp is one of the keccak256 inputs generating the token hash, making the result miner-influenceable.
The string returned by hash() is stored as the token hash during minting.
hash() reads and writes hashToMinted to avoid collisions and recurses on duplicates.
SEED_NONCE is incremented each round and appended to the hashed preimage.
MAX_SUPPLY is the bound in the 'totalSupply().add(_quantity) <= MAX_SUPPLY' check.
MAX_SUPPLY participates in the bakePizza supply arithmetic together with RESERVED.
RESERVED is subtracted from MAX_SUPPLY inside the bakePizza supply requirement.
RESERVED is required to be at least 1 and is decremented in privateMint.
RESERVED is bounded and decremented in bakeReservedPizza.
RESERVED is bounded and decremented in giveAway.
The _paused flag gates the public mint path in bakePizza.
onlyOwner pause() writes the _paused flag.
privateMint reads and clears _privateSaleWhitelist[msg.sender], the core authorisation check.
updateWhitelist writes true into _privateSaleWhitelist for each supplied address.
hashToSVG reads traitTypes arrays to build the SVG rectangles.
hashToMetadata reads traitTypes arrays to build the JSON attributes.
addTraitType lets the owner push arbitrary Trait structs into traitTypes.
clearTraits lets the owner delete ranges of traitTypes, mutating rendering data.
_tokenIdToHash returns tokenIdToHash[_tokenId].
mintInternal writes the freshly generated hash into tokenIdToHash.
hash() calls rarityGen for each of the nine hash characters.
tokenURI embeds the SVG produced by hashToSVG.
tokenURI embeds the metadata produced by hashToMetadata.
tokenURI resolves the token hash through _tokenIdToHash.
tokenURI indirectly reads the tokenIdToHash mapping via _tokenIdToHash.
mintInternal performs the off-by-one loop and index addition that constitute the unsafe arithmetic.
bakeReservedPizza executes RESERVED -= _amount before minting.
giveAway executes RESERVED -= _amount before minting.
bakePizza compares msg.value to PUBLIC_MINT_PRICE without refunding or enforcing exactness.
withdrawFunds reads the balance and performs the outgoing transfer in the same call.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external call into the recipient contract.
The recipient callback receives msg.sender-derived operator data and can re-enter contract logic.
_msgSender() is forwarded as the operator argument of onERC721Received.
The constructor assigns _owner = msg.sender, creating a shadow owner separate from Ownable.
The constructor populates traitTypes and TIERS with the initial trait configuration.
bakePizza delegates minting to mintInternal.
privateMint delegates minting to mintInternal.
bakeReservedPizza delegates minting to mintInternal.
giveAway delegates minting to mintInternal.
Caller-supplied _quantity controls how many tokens bakePizza mints.
_quantity bounds the mintInternal loop and the supply check.
_amount is subtracted from RESERVED and passed to mintInternal.
_amount is subtracted from RESERVED and passed to mintInternal.
_to is used as the mint recipient in giveAway.
_tokenId selects the token whose URI is rendered.
_wallet selects the owner whose token ids are enumerated.
_traitTypeIndex selects the traitTypes slot appended by the owner.
whitelist entries are written into _privateSaleWhitelist.
val is written into the _paused flag.
_hash selects trait indexes parsed for SVG generation.
_hash selects trait indexes parsed for metadata generation.
currentHash accumulates the generated characters inside hash().
_totalSupply bases the token id arithmetic in the mint loop.
thisTokenId = _totalSupply + i is the derived id written to storage.
balance is read from address(this).balance and then transferred.
currentLowerBound accumulates TIERS percentages during rarity lookup.

normalization_plan.reason: The _quantity parameter only shapes the public mint call into mintInternal and carries no independent security semantics.
The internal _quantity parameter is fully subsumed by the mintInternal loop arithmetic unsafe operation.
_amount is only the operand of the RESERVED decrement performed by bakeReservedPizza.
_amount is only the operand of the RESERVED decrement performed by giveAway.
_to is merely forwarded as the mint recipient of giveAway.
_tokenId is only used to look up the hash for the tokenURI rendering path.
_wallet is only the enumeration subject of walletOfOwner.
_traitTypeIndex is only the array index written by the owner-only addTraitType.
The whitelist array is only the input written into _privateSaleWhitelist by updateWhitelist.
val is only the boolean written to _paused by the owner-only pause function.
_hash is only the parsed input of the pure view SVG renderer.
_hash is only the parsed input of the pure view metadata renderer.
currentHash is the transient accumulator internal to the hash randomness routine.
_totalSupply is the base of the token-id arithmetic evaluated by the mintInternal loop.
thisTokenId is the per-iteration result of the unchecked index addition in mintInternal.
balance is the transient value read and immediately transferred by withdrawFunds.
currentLowerBound is the transient accumulation cursor internal to the rarity tier scan.
